name: LinkMap
headline:
A little coordination.
A meaningful difference.
summary: A place to organize feeding activities for people experiencing homelessness.
image_alt: Illustration of connected gathering points on a neighborhood map
intro: LinkMap is an Endsunset project focused on the organization of feeding activities for people experiencing homelessness. It brings a practical purpose to a simple idea: connecting people around care for their community.

details.title: People at the center.
details.text: A project with a focus on people experiencing homelessness and the communities around them.

details.title: A shared purpose.
details.text: Centered on organizing feeding activities and bringing people together to help.
